profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at 120Water
profile.summary:
I am a seasoned technology leader with more than 20 years of experience designing, architecting, and delivering enterprise software solutions across the software development, cloud computing, and technology consulting sectors. Recognized for demonstrating a natural aptitude for software architecture, technical leadership, and enterprise application development, I have a verifiable history of contributing directly to business growth, digital transformation, and engineering excellence throughout my career. Professional focal points include Agile methodologies, microservices architecture, RESTful API development, system modernization, DevOps practices, team mentoring, cross-functional collaboration, and enterprise application design. Delivering superior results across these areas requires technical strategy, systems analysis, problem-solving, and project leadership skills to support innovation, operational excellence, and long-term business success.

Currently, I serve as Tech Lead with AssistRx, where I architect enterprise integrations, lead multiple Agile development teams, and oversee the design and delivery of scalable software solutions that improve interoperability and application performance. I also mentor software engineers, establish engineering best practices, develop reusable frameworks that accelerate client implementations, and collaborate closely with business stakeholders to align technical strategy with organizational objectives. 

Colleagues describe me as a collaborative, innovative, solutions-oriented technology leader who combines deep technical expertise with strong business acumen and a passion for developing high-performing engineering teams.

I am interested in connecting with former colleagues, engineering leaders, software architects, cloud professionals, technology executives, and other professionals. Please feel free to connect with me.

positions.title: Sr Tech Lead
positions.description:
Tech Lead 
•	Architect integrations between newly acquired applications and Salesforce to streamline data exchange and improve interoperability across enterprise platforms.
•	Develop reusable boilerplate frameworks and branded site templates that accelerate client implementations while ensuring consistency and maintainability.
•	Enhance enterprise applications by delivering new features, resolving complex defects, and continuously improving system performance and reliability.
•	Oversee multiple Agile development teams of 5–10 engineers by providing technical direction, removing blockers, and ensuring successful project delivery.
•	Take charge of mentoring developers through coaching, knowledge sharing, and hands-on technical guidance to elevate code quality and engineering best practices.
•	Define project requirements, develop technical solutions, and allocate resources to meet delivery timelines and business objectives.
•	Prioritize development roadmaps, sprint deliverables, and engineering initiatives to align with organizational goals and customer needs.
•	Conduct comprehensive code reviews that promote coding standards, maintainability, performance optimization, and long-term scalability.

positions.title: Sr Design Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer & Architect (Contract)
•	Architected cloud migration strategies that transitioned legacy on-premises applications to scalable cloud-based infrastructure. 
•	Established enterprise standards and architectural guidelines for designing, deploying, and managing cloud-native applications. 
•	Developed AWS Lambda functions using Java and JavaScript to support serverless, event-driven business processes. 
•	Engineered internal microservices utilizing Java Spring and Spring Boot to improve application scalability and service reliability.

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer/Architect
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer & Architect (Contract)
•	Modernized legacy enterprise applications by migrating them to Angular 4, Core Java, and Microsoft SQL Server.
•	Designed reusable frameworks and standards for transforming Web Objects applications into RESTful services using Java Spring.
•	Directed technical implementation efforts by overseeing module conversion, testing, deployment, and production readiness.
•	Championed Test-Driven Development (TDD) practices to improve software quality, maintainability, and defect prevention.

positions.title: Lead Sr Programmer
positions.description:
•	Delivered enterprise software solutions for both client engagements and proprietary company products across multiple industries.
•	Supervised development teams of five or more engineers while providing technical leadership and project oversight.
•	Coached developers through technical mentoring, code reviews, and troubleshooting to improve delivery quality and team performance.
•	Collaborated directly with clients and stakeholders to gather business requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
